verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch offers a documented one-liner local-dev/Docker quickstart (start-local, Docker Compose) that spins up a fully isolated Elasticsearch+Kibana instance with security disabled for testing, and this was independently verified via runtime probe to boot, index, and query data with no production connection at all. Free trial serverless projects also provide isolated sandbox environments. missing for 10: no explicit vendor documentation framing this as an 'AI agent sandbox/test environment' concept, and no dedicated ephemeral/disposable sandbox-as-a-service offering beyond local Docker or trial projects.
